verdicts.reason: Both make the same structural mistakes. The upside-down owl is cut off with a hard horizontal edge in mid-canvas instead of bleeding off the top. The blue owl's body ends abruptly above the bottom edge, so it floats. A pink star sits on 'PARTIES'. 'EVENT MANAGMENT' is pulled away from the headline and stacked on top of the cropped owl. A keeps a little more right margin and better balance. B enlarges the headline until 'KIDS DIRTHDAY' nearly touches the right edge, and its red eyebrow text is jammed against the owl's crop line.
